In 2006-2007, it served almost 50,000 students, excluding those in adult, alternative, and Community Education programs. ==History== Education in the former [[Halton County]] was previously governed by a framework of boards for various high school districts and public school districts associated with them.as provided under {{Cite canlaw|short title =The Secondary Schools and Boards of Education Act|abbr =R.S.O.|year =1960|chapter =362|link= https://archive.org/stream/v4revisedstatuteso1960ontauoft#page/656/mode/2up}} In 1967, as a result of initiatives undertaken by then [[Ministry of Education (Ontario)|Minister of Education]] [[Bill Davis]], work was begun to amalgamate all boards on a county-wide level throughout the Province, and such a move was recommended to the [[Halton County Council]] that year for its approval.{{cite news |author= |title= Study single board of education|url= http://news.milton.halinet.on.ca/2497808/page/1?n=13&q=\%22Halton%20County%20Board%20of%20Education\%22|newspaper= The Canadian Champion|location= Milton|date= May 3, 1967|page= 1}} The move was opposed by the southern boards of education in [[Burlington, Ontario|Burlington]] and [[Oakville, Ontario|Oakville]],{{cite news |author= |title= A direction for education|url= http://news.milton.halinet.on.ca/2497837/page/17|newspaper= The Canadian Champion|location= Milton|date= November 22, 1967|page= C1}} but that was overruled upon passage of mandatory legislation by the [[Legislative Assembly of Ontario]] in 1968.''The Secondary Schools and Boards of Education Act'', R.S.O. 1960, c. 362, Part VI , as inserted by {{Cite canlaw|short title =The Secondary Schools and Boards of Education Amendment Act, 1968|abbr =S.O.|year =1968|chapter =122|section = 8|link= https://archive.org/stream/statutesofprovin1968onta#page/548/mode/2up}} The Board was constituted as the '''Halton County Board of Education''', which was established on January 1, 1969.{{cite news |author= |title= Oakville headquarters for County Board of Education|url= http://news.milton.halinet.on.ca/2498144/page/1?n=17&q=\%22Halton%20County%20Board%20of%20Education\%22|newspaper= The Canadian Champion|location= Milton|date= January 15, 1969|page= 1}} When the County was replaced by the [[Regional Municipality of Halton]], the Board became the '''Halton Board of Education'''.{{Cite canlaw|short title =The Regional Municipality of Halton Act, 1973|abbr =S.O.|year =1973|chapter =70|section = 139|link= https://archive.org/stream/statutesofprovin1973onta#page/468/mode/2up}} As part of the province-wide restructuring of Ontario's school boards as a consequence of the passage of the ''Fewer School Boards Act, 1997'',{{Cite canlaw|short title =Fewer School Boards Act, 1997|abbr =S.O.|year =1997|chapter =3|link= https://archive.org/stream/v01statutesofont1997ontauoft#page/30/mode/2up}} the '''English-language Public District School Board No. 20''' was created to take over the Region's schools.{{Cite canlaw|link = https://www.ontario.ca/laws/regulation/970460|type = reg|regtitle = Transition from Old Boards to District School Boards |regnumber = O. Reg. 460/97}} It was merged with the former Board at the beginning of 1998, and was renamed as the "Halton District School Board" in 1999.{{Cite canlaw|link = https://www.ontario.ca/laws/regulation/970185|type = reg|regtitle = Establishment, Areas of Jurisdiction, and Names of District School Boards|regnumber = O. Reg. 185/97}} ==Schools== The Board operates 76 elementary schools, and 17 secondary schools, which are organized into the following areas: * East Area (Oakville) * North Area (Halton Hills and Milton) * West Area (Burlington) Secondary school enrolment and [[Fraser Institute]] provincial rankings are as follows: {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align:right" |+ HDSB secondary schools (2018 Fraser Institute Rankings){{Cite web|title = Report Card on Ontario's Secondary Schools 2018|url = https://www.fraserinstitute.org/sites/default/files/ontario-secondary-school-rankings-2018.pdf|date = February 18, 2018|publisher = [[Fraser Institute]]}} |- ! scope="col" | Name ! scope="col" | Area ! scope="col" | Enrolment ! scope="col" | 1-year ranking of 747 ! scope="col" | 5-year ranking of 623 |- |style="text-align:left"| [[Abbey Park High School]] || East || 954 || 2 || 9 |- |style="text-align:left"| [[Garth Webb Secondary School]] || East ||1092 || 33 ||42 |- |style="text-align:left"| [[Iroquois Ridge High School]] || East || 1358 || 25 || 12 |- |style="text-align:left"| [[Oakville Trafalgar High School]] || East || 1245 || 11 || 9 |- |style="text-align:left"| [[T. for adult, alternative and Community Education programs. *[https://syl.hdsb.ca/ Syl Apps School] == Programming == The Pathways programme encourages all post-secondary options, from apprenticeship, to college, to university, to the workplace.{{cite web |title=Pathways Program |url=https://www.hdsb.ca/learning-and-resources/Pages/Secondary%20Education%20and%20Pathways/Pathways-Program.aspx |publisher=Halton District School Board |access-date=April 14, 2020}} The Board has also introduced specialist high skills majors and other unique programs for students, including fully online high school credits.{{cite web |title=eLearning |url=https://www.hdsb.ca/learning-and-resources/Pages/Secondary%20Education%20and%20Pathways/eLearning.aspx |publisher=Halton District School Board |access-date=April 14, 2020}} The [[IB Diploma Programme|International Baccalaureate]] programme is offered at: * [[Georgetown District High School]] * [[Burlington Central High School]] * [[White Oaks Secondary School]] * [[Craig Kielburger Secondary School]] (IBDP candidate school){{cite web |title=International Baccalaureate (IB) Program |url=https://www.hdsb.ca/learning-and-resources/Pages/Secondary%20Education%20and%20Pathways/International-Baccalaureate-(IB)-Program.aspx |publisher=Halton District School Board |access-date=April 14, 2020}} ==See also== * [[Halton Catholic District School Board]] * [[Ontario Student Trustees' Association]] * [[List of school districts in Ontario]] * [[List of high schools in Ontario]] ==References== {{reflist|2}} [[Category:School districts in Ontario]] [[Category:Education in Burlington, Ontario]] [[Category:Education in the Regional Municipality of Halton]]
